mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (sympathomimetic stimulant) may antagonize the antipsychotic effects of perphenazine while perphenazine can potentiate CNS depression and increase risk of arrhythmias due to additive effects on cardiac conduction and dopamine antagonism.
action: Use combination cautiously with close monitoring for reduced antipsychotic efficacy, cardiac arrhythmias, and excessive CNS effects; consider alternative antipsychotic with less cardiac liability if stimulant use is necessary.
